# Research report 1 of 2

Search is done and I'm writing up the pre-match findings now. Anything published after 2026-09-18 has been left out.

## 1. Resolution source
- The primary source is UEFA's official match centre, with Flashscore and then Sofascore as fallbacks. As of the cutoff the game had not been played, so there was no result. Only a Norway win in 90 minutes plus stoppage time counts as "Yes". A draw counts as "No".

## 2. Current status
- 2026-09-18: Nothing settles the question yet. The match is six days away, and I found no reports of a postponement.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- Sept 2026 (undated previews): Norway striker Alexander Sørloth is reported out injured, and Jens Petter Hauge is listed as injured. Haaland and Ødegaard are expected to be available. [Heavy](https://heavy.com/sports/soccer/norway-vs-denmark-lineup-today-confirmed-team-news-starting-xi/), [Sportsdunia](https://www.sportsdunia.com/football-teams/norway-national-football-team-injuries)
- Sept 2026: Reports on Denmark's absences differ. Andreas Christensen is described as out (one source cites a thigh injury), Alexander Bah as withdrawn with a shoulder problem, and Kasper Dolberg as injured in training. Coach Brian Riemer reportedly called up Lucas Høgsberg, Anton Gaaei and Mohamed Daramy as replacements. [Betshoot](https://www.betshoot.com/football/202455-Norway-vs-Denmark-prediction/), [Watchathletics](https://www.watchathletics.com/schedule/watchlive/12277)
- Ståle Solbakken is still Norway's coach. The group also includes Portugal and Wales, and the reverse fixture against Denmark is in November. [Tapmad](https://www.tapmad.com/blog/norway-vs-denmark-preview-uefa-nations-league-2026-27/8189-5-0)
- 2026-07: Norway lost their World Cup quarter-final 2-1 to England after extra time. It was their first World Cup quarter-final. [Deccan Chronicle](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/sports/fifa-wc-2026-haaland-bids-emotional-goodbye-to-usa-after-norways-qf-exit-1970532)
- 2026-07-05: Norway knocked Brazil out 2-1 in the round of 16 with two late Haaland goals. Before that they beat Ivory Coast 2-1 in the round of 32, their first-ever World Cup knockout win. Haaland scored 7 goals at the tournament. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/soccer/erling-haaland-ends-brazils-world-cup-brace-norway-round-16), [ProPakistani](https://propakistani.pk/2026/07/06/norway-knock-brazil-out-to-reach-first-ever-fifa-world-cup-quarter-finals/)
- I could not find Denmark's 2026 World Cup results in my searches.

## 4. Base rates
- The head-to-head favours Denmark. One preview says Denmark are unbeaten in six straight meetings (four wins). Another says Norway have not beaten Denmark since April 1998. The last competitive meeting was a 2-0 Denmark win in Euro qualifying in September 2011. [Sports Mole](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/nations-league/norway-vs-denmark_game_258873.html), [Tapmad](https://www.tapmad.com/blog/norway-vs-denmark-preview-uefa-nations-league-2026-27/8189-5-0)
- For reference, home sides in closely matched European internationals usually win about 45-50% of the time, and about 25% of these games end in draws. This is a general reference figure, not one I verified for this matchup.
- Norway's recent form is strong: they reached the World Cup quarter-finals, and Haaland scored in every group game.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Bookmaker prices from undated pre-match previews:
  - 7bet: Norway 1.62, draw 4.20, Denmark 4.50, which implies about 58-60% for Norway.
  - Another book: Norway -139 (about 58%), Denmark +330. [Oddschecker](https://www.oddschecker.com/tips/football/uefa-nations-league/20260924-norway-vs-denmark-predictions-bet-builder-tips-lineups-odds-2), [Scoresandstats](https://www.scoresandstats.com/predictions/soccer/uefa-nations-league/norway-vs-denmark-picks-predictions-and-odds/)

- Club fixtures over the weekend of 2026-09-19/20 could cause late injuries, especially to Haaland or Ødegaard.
- Denmark's injury list, possibly including Christensen and Bah, could change before kickoff.
- Odds may move as team news comes in. Norway play Portugal three days later, so some rotation is possible, though it is unlikely in the opening game.

## 4. Base rates
- Head to head clearly favours Denmark:
  - Denmark is unbeaten in the last six meetings (4 wins, 2 draws), and one source counts the last seven as 4 wins and 3 draws.
  - Norway has not beaten Denmark since 2000 and has not beaten them at home since 1994.

  - All five previous meetings in Norway saw both teams score.
  - Sources disagree on the totals. [ESPN](https://africa.espn.com/football/match/_/gameId/401861046/denmark-norway), [Sports Mole](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/norway/uefa-nations-league/preview/norway-vs-denmark-prediction-team-news-lineups_605603.html)
- Current form:
  - Norway has won 14 of its 24 Nations League matches, about 58%, but all of those came in Leagues B and C.
  - Norway qualified for the 2026 World Cup.
  - Denmark has won 1 of its last 5 completed games.
  - [Sports Mole](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/norway/uefa-nations-league/preview/norway-vs-denmark-prediction-team-news-lineups_605603.html)
- General rule of thumb: in evenly matched European internationals, home teams win roughly 45% of the time and about 25% end in draws.

## 5. Other forecasts
